name: Selenium
author: Kent
keynote: Marked mental and physical weakness following prolonged fevers, after sexual excesses, from secret vice, from exposure to the heat of the sun in summer.

name: Senecio aureus
author: Kent
keynote: Senecio Aureus In some parts of the country where it grows it is called Golden Ragwort, in others Huckleroot.

name: Senega
author: Kent
keynote: Senega is an old lung tonic, and I suspect it has been an ingredient in most of the lung medicines for the last one hundred years.

name: Sepia
author: Kent
keynote: Sepia is suited to tall, slim women with narrow pelvis and lax fibers and muscles; such a woman is not well built as a woman.

name: Silicea
author: Kent
keynote: The action of Silica is slow. In the proving, it takes a long time to develop the symptoms. It is, therefore, suited to complaints that develop slowly.

name: Spigelia anthelmia
author: Kent
keynote: Spigelia Anthelmintica Pains: Spigelia is especially known by its pains.

name: Spongia tosta
author: Kent
keynote: Spongia Tosta Mind: The mental symptoms of Spongia show that it is a heart remedy.

name: Squilla
author: Kent
keynote: Squilla was given in the olden times by the old school in all lung, bronchial, and kidney affections; pneumonia, asthma, scanty urine and dropsical affections.

name: Stannum metallicum
author: Kent
keynote: Stannum Metallicum Stannum is especially suited to persons who have long been growing feeble.

name: Staphysagria
author: Kent
keynote: The mental symptoms are very important, and the impressions made upon the mind and thence upon the body guide to Staphysagria as a remedy.

name: Stramonium
author: Kent
keynote: When considering Stram. the idea of violence comes into mind.

name: Sulfuricum acidum
author: Kent
keynote: Sulphuricum Acidum The sensation of quivering all over the body and in the limbs without visible trembling is a very strong symptom of Sulphuric acid, and especially if it is associated with weakness

name: Syphillinum
author: Kent
keynote: Syphilinum Whenever the symptoms that are representative of the patient himself have been suppressed in any case of syphilis, and nothing remains but weakness and a few results of the storm that has l

name: Tarentula hispana
author: Kent
keynote: Tarentula Hispanica This terrible poison should never be used except in attenuations.

name: Theridion
author: Kent
keynote: Hysterical sensitivity with extreme aggravation from noise, motion and exertion marks this remedy as unique.

name: Tuberculinum bovinum
author: Kent
keynote: Tuberculinum Bovinum I want to take up the study of Tuberculinum.

name: Valeriana
author: Kent
keynote: This remedy cures many nervous and hysterical phenomena in excitable women and children, and the complaints of the hypochondriac.

name: Veratrum album
author: Kent
keynote: Veratrum Album You will be astonished at the wonderful coldness running through this remedy.

name: Zincum metallicum
author: Kent
keynote: Zincum Metallicum Zinc. has a full and substantial proving, including symptoms of every part of the body. It is an antipsoric, suitable in broken down constitutions, feeble constitutions; enfeeblement
